purpose: Bounded post-hoc input adaptation screen, not replacement of 180-class main experiment
fonts: all six existing training fonts; leave one font out
inverted: 255-original_uint8; tests display polarity only; not a physically different SPV simulation
sqrt_brightened: RGB uint8 round(255*sqrt(u)); fixed gamma=0.5, no other gamma search; increases faint phosphene visibility
unchanged: CLIP RN50 weights, 7 Chinese prompts, prototype core and alpha grid from prior frozen protocol
selection: Choose PA0 and PA1 alpha separately on 3 selection maps using existing choose function. Choose display by PA1 selection accuracy; tie order original,inverted,sqrt_brightened. Save decision before scoring confirmation maps.
confirmation: Score all predeclared variants for transparency, but never change selected display from confirmation scores
engineering_followup_gate: Selected non-original PA1 must improve both selection and confirmation by at least 5 percentage points vs original PA1, with confirmation accuracy >=20 percent, to recommend a full 180-class DEV verification. These are resource triage thresholds, not statistical significance.
forbidden: Do not load E1/C1 images, features, predictions, or use their scores; do not change encoder/core, add more candidates, or retune on confirmation
scope_limits: Historical DEV data, post-hoc analysis; not fresh blinded holdout. 60-way feature-column normalization and class difficulty differ from 180-way; no cross-task ranking.
